name: json2model
description: A local browser tool that converts JSON into Dart, TypeScript, and Pydantic models.
author: JSON2Model contributors

scripts.validate:python: npm run fixtures:generate && python -m ruff check tests/generated/python && python tests/generated/python/validate.py
scripts.validate:dart: npm run fixtures:generate && dart analyze tests/generated/dart && dart run tests/generated/dart/round_trip.dart
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

overrides: Pulls a patched build dependency without waiting for the package that
depends on it. @babel/core covers GHSA-4x5r-pxfx-6jf8 and reaches the
project through @vitejs/plugin-react. It is a build tool and does not
brace-expansion stays on its compatible 1.x line while including the
js-yaml is constrained to the patched 4.x release used by build tools.
